title: Deadline and Debt
author: Jude Villalobos
blurb: Beatrix Almeida, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
